(2) monitor/social/ -> append_only_glob: report-YYYY-MM-DD*.json live at the directory top level next to mutable siblings; mirrors the monitor/decisions/ + monitor/tinker/ mixed-directory precedent — explicit per-file entries (wayback-*.json git; cost-history.jsonl + human-notes-archive.jsonl git-append-only) override the glob, and walkAppendOnly is skip-if-exists so mutable siblings (human-notes.json, latest-summary.txt) can never be clobbered by it. workspace-sync.md deliberately NOT edited: NEVER_PUSH is wrong semantics for append-only artifacts (none of the other append_only dirs are listed there; FUSE->git rescue of NEW files is legitimate).
